C1469.title: Cyberattack on a German Steel Mill Causes Physical Damage
C1469.summary: Germany's Federal Office for Information Security disclosed in its 2014 annual report that a German steel mill had suffered a targeted cyberattack. The attackers entered the office network through spear phishing and social engineering, progressively reached the production network, and controlled multiple system components. A blast furnace could not be shut down as planned, causing significant physical damage; the report did not identify the company or attackers.
